supported.description: Multiple observations are consistent with the hypothesis but do not prove it.

contradicted.description: Available evidence materially conflicts with the hypothesis.

reasoning_rules.rule: Correlation or temporal alignment alone must not be described as proof of causation.
A proxy metric must not be presented as direct measurement unless the metric catalog explicitly defines that relationship.
Absence of a required metric must result in an evidence gap, not an inferred value.
A confirmed impairment must not automatically be promoted to a physical root cause.
Evidence that materially contradicts a hypothesis should be reported, not omitted.
Prefer evidence that distinguishes competing hypotheses over collecting additional unrelated metrics.
When remaining hypotheses require evidence outside the current domain, return the evidence gap and recommend the appropriate domain rather than continuing redundant investigation.
